drivingQuestion: Why must two members of a court that saw the moon testify before the others?
outcomeNote: The question is answered by Rabbi Zeira in the next unit

segments.he: רָאוּהוּ בֵּית דִּין — יַעַמְדוּ שְׁנַיִם וְיָעִידוּ בִּפְנֵיהֶם. וְאַמַּאי? לֹא תְּהֵא שְׁמִיעָה גְּדוֹלָה מֵרְאִיָּיה!
segments.en: § The mishna continues: If «the court» alone «saw» the new moon, «two» members of the court «should stand and testify before the others.» The Gemara ponders: If the court saw the new moon, «why» is it necessary for two of its members to testify before the others? «Hearing» their testimony «should not be greater than» actually «seeing» the new moon.
